lastCompletedStory.title: Drop session_id from state-file writer + vendored template

nextStoryContext: US-001 removed session_id from the state-file writer and template. The LoopState type in status.ts still has an optional session_id field (permissive reader for legacy files) -- that is intentional and not in scope for this story. test/attach-hint.test.ts was not listed in the story notes but also had sessionId in runNext calls; always grep all test files when removing a field from NextOptions.
